title: LeanForth tactic step log, format version 1: one line
description: Every line of the step log `leanforth check --steps FILE|- TEXT.lf` writes (plan S2, branch s2-steps; docs/design/S2_INTERFACE.md section 6; src/front/step-log.fs): for each declaration of the text with a tactic proof that the kernel accepted, in the text's order, one header line ({"tactic_steps": ...}) and then one line per step, in the order the steps took effect. A step's goals are printed as `.goals` prints them (Lean's trace_state): the case tag, the hypotheses and the target, lines joined by line feeds. Presentation data: nothing reads it to decide, and it changes no verdict. Version 1 does not yet carry each tactic's rule fields, the constants and hypotheses a step used, or the goals in kernel form (docs/design/S2_INTERFACE.md appendix C).
$comment: Uses only the keywords that tests/support/schema_subset.py implements.

axioms.description: Every axiom the declaration depends on, as #print axioms names them (sorryAx for a by-sorry). The declaration is proved only when open_parts is 0 and each axiom is one of the allowlisted propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; otherwise the report calls it NOT PROVED. null when an axiom's name could not be given (never a short list); the log is then an error, exit 3.

cut.description: true when the step log ran out of room while the text ran, before this declaration's end: its steps are left out (steps is 0), and any declaration whose header found no room is missing. The verdicts and the exit code are as without the log, except when memory is exhausted (the log's text shares room with the open parts').

open_parts.description: The declaration's open parts (by-sorry, Lean's sorry): each one makes it NOT PROVED.

steps.description: How many step lines follow (0 when cut).

goal_before.description: The main goal before the step, or null when the step ran with no goal in focus (an alternative or case taking its goal).

goals_after.description: The goals in focus once the step took effect.

parent.description: The step of the block the step ran in (an induction's with, an alternative, a case), 0 for the proof's own steps.

source.description: The step's word in the text: line:column, from 1.

step.description: The step's number in its declaration, from 1, in the order taking effect.

tactic.description: The tactic's name as Lean or Mathlib names it (owner [format] decision, 2026-11-17: any well-formed name, not a fixed list, so that later tactics such as norm_num, exact? or cases' need no new format). LeanForth writes rfl, exact, intro, induction, alternative, case, rewrite, rw, sorry, apply, assumption and constructor today.

word.description: The LeanForth word that wrote the step: any non-blank token (by-rfl, by-exact, by-intro:, by-induction, by-induction-with, |, by-case:, by-rewrite[, by-rw[, by-sorry, by-apply, by-assumption and by-constructor today).
